name: leave-management-tool-root
description: Root folder for Leave Management Tool to run client and server concurrently

scripts.install-all: npm.cmd install && cd client && npm.cmd install && cd ../server && npm.cmd install
scripts.e2e:exploratory: npx playwright test e2e/tests/security.spec.ts e2e/tests/shifts.spec.ts e2e/tests/tenant-auth-kiosk.spec.ts e2e/tests/tenant-auth-rate-limit.spec.ts e2e/tests/voice-commands-permissions-security.spec.ts e2e/tests/voice-commands-validation.spec.ts --reporter=html --workers=2
